headline: Brand Designer
tagline: Brand and visual designer experienced in building reusable design systems, visual identities, and 100+ digital and print marketing assets.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, design systems, social/marketing creative

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy for marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders across low revision cycles.
Applied typography, colour systems, layout, and visual hierarchy across all brand touchpoints.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing, feeding findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Produced wireframes and prototypes for digital products.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff using Photoshop and Illustrator.

projects.name: Branding kit for AT Creation startup
bullets: Delivered logo, typography, and palette for visual identity and brand systems work.

projects.name: Social campaign for a fashion brand
bullets: Executed Instagram and Facebook series resulting in a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her 100+ brand and marketing creatives at Ascent Business Solutions and her experience building reusable visual systems to match the Brand Designer role requirements.
omitted: AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) omitted as the posting does not prioritize AI tooling.
